Why wait for the money to talk about the jet?

Kevin Trudeau tells of sitting on a private plane with a group of men who complained about commercial flight delays. One of them said they should talk about a jet once they had the money.

Kevin's answer was to talk about it now. He says the dreaming has to come before you can afford it.

What are you waiting to dream about until you can afford it?
